items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: Irving Mills was the impresario... Irving Mills heard me in California... Irving Mills came in the place... 'Want you to go with Ellington.'

ctx.x: Had You met Duke at that time?

No, the first time I saw him was the next day, and the next day, which was Wednesday, I went down. He told me to come down to the Orpheum Theater, and I went down there. And he says, "I never knew you," Duke says, "I never knew you, I never met you, I never heard you. But Irving says get you, so that's that." So, well, "How much you paying?" Well, now, I had never been East, and I always looked at a thing that gave me an opportunity to do something that I wanted to do, wasn't so much the money. It was the…
